manifest_scope: Author-provided analysis metadata and artifact identifiers. This manifest is not an independent audit and does not establish pre-evaluation chronology.
recorded_selection_basis: According to the author-provided workflow record, model families were selected from the Sheet1 grouped nested-cross-validation results reported in Figure 4.

deployment_mapping.Y02: derived as predicted Y01 multiplied by predicted Y03

recorded_hyperparameter_selection: Five-fold GroupKFold grid search on Sheet1, scored by negative RMSE.
recorded_uncertainty_method: Symmetric 90% and 95% empirical prediction intervals derived from formula-group maxima of nested-CV out-of-fold absolute residuals.
recorded_descriptor_distance_method: Continuous nearest-neighbour seven-descriptor-space distance percentile relative to Sheet1 leave-one-formula-group-out distances.
recorded_test_policy: The author-provided workflow designated Sheet2 for use after model selection and fitting. The repository contains no independently timestamped pre-evaluation model release and therefore does not independently establish when Sheet2 reference values were first accessed.
claim_boundary: Research-stage physicochemical prescreening of pure hydrocarbon molecules only; not external validation, finished-fuel certification, sustainability assessment, or engine-performance verification.

public_deidentified_artifacts.deidentification_boundary: Molecule names, molecular formulae, original development-record identifiers, and bilingual display metadata were removed. X01-X07 vectors remain for applicability-domain calculations and may be linkable to a known source dataset.
public_deidentified_artifacts.hash_status: Public artifact hashes populated after metadata reduction and semantic-equivalence checks.
